fields.label: Inverter Type
fields.description: String, Optimiser or Micro. Choose first; Inverter Make then lists only makes of this type.

fields.label: Inverter Capacity (kW)
fields.description: e.g. 5, 4 or 1 kW. Total inverter capacity must be 0.85x to 2x the total panel capacity.

fields.label: No. of Inverters
fields.description: Leave blank to work it out from the panel capacity.

fields.label: Inverter Phase
fields.description: Left blank, it is set from the connection. Single phase users: single phase inverters up to 5 kW each. Three phase users: inverters above 5 kW must be three phase.

fields.label: Inverter Make
fields.description: Makes of the chosen Inverter Type only.

fields.label: Option
fields.description: An alternative inverter offered to the customer: shown on the estimate and proposal, but not added to the commercials or counted in the system's size.

fields.label: Nos
fields.description: Total panel capacity / Inverter Capacity, rounded up.

fields.label: Option
fields.description: The ticked inverter option this inverter row came from (package, or package|make). Rebuilt from the ticked options on save; a row without it was added by hand and is kept.

name: Design Estimate Inverter
description: The inverters an estimate is designed with; the count follows from the total panel capacity.
